versions.name: K-M Scout Ranch

features.note: Miles of ATV trails, with a pre-camp e-course and a dedicated ATV course.
Underwater cameras in a spring-fed pond support STEM and trout study.
A range and target activities area.
A Missouri River canoe trek of more than fifty miles.
A modern lodge and dining hall with a Scoutmaster lounge.
Flush toilets and showers near every campsite.

versions.summary: Montana Council Scouts BSA resident camp in the Moccasin Mountains near Lewistown, offering ATV and mountain bike trails, aquatics, STEM and trout study, climbing, and range and target activities.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
